positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
I lead the Studio Orchestrator Platform team.

The Studio Orchestrator platform provides a powerful stateful process orchestration system which serves as the underpinning for building several content production workflows in Live Action, Animation and Visual Effects spaces.

positions.title: Director
positions.description:
Interactive Collaboration Platform (similar to Slack, growing 5-7% a week)
•	Designed and developed low-latency, high throughput scalable self-healing services to manage presence and real-time communication, broadcast/push messaging based on several open source technologies including Websockets/Netty, Atmosphere, Hazelcast running on AWS. 
•	Responsible for several infrastructure services including an extensible user and app permissions service, user management service, graph service, files service, and more based on open source technologies including jetty
•	Established continuous deployment build system with several releases a day.

•	Hired and led a team of stellar engineers.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
•	Automated common operational issues and built a self-healing system that fixes itself.
Microservices Platform
•	Designed and co-authored the cloud ready micro-services platform to replace the legacy PHP/LAMP based labor marketplace doing over 400M+ in transactions. 
•	Facilitated the move to EC2 and adoption of noSQL datastores.
•	Instituted the continuous delivery process and system
•	Hired and led a team of stellar engineers.
